'''Jerid Sykes''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] male and former [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who served as [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]]. Sykes was a veteran of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] who deserted the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order]] and eventually joined the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] and become part of [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Tyber Zann]] inner circle. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he commanded the [[Keldabe-class cruiser|''Keldabe''-class battleship]] ''[[End of Days]]'' and its fleet [[Battle between Ord Mantell and Genassa|against]] the pirates of the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]].<ref name="MotPQ" />
